topicLedger.title: Local-full coverage is complete
topicLedger.decision: Treat the completed local-full lane as diagnostic evidence only; full SOTA and production claims still require the provider/full-memory gates.
topicLedger.nextAction: Run combine, memory-score, reviewer, and provider/full-memory gates before any public claim changes.

topicLedger.title: BM25 remains the lexical floor
topicLedger.decision: Keep BM25 in every fair comparison and use it as the fallback/control arm.
topicLedger.nextAction: Compare every promoted retrieval method against BM25 on the same accepted shard set.

topicLedger.title: Local Apple rerank is the current local winner
topicLedger.evidence: local-apple-qwen3-0_6b-local-rerank score 24.9; delta vs BM25 2.738; delta vs base 4.23.
topicLedger.decision: Treat local rerank as the current method-refinement candidate, not as a public benchmark claim.
topicLedger.nextAction: Keep local rerank through final combine and memory-score gates.

topicLedger.title: Plain full-hybrid is not promoted on current answer-quality evidence
topicLedger.decision: Do not treat deterministic full-hybrid as superior on the current accepted-shard aggregation.
topicLedger.nextAction: Use per-shard diagnostics to identify whether dense or rerank ordering is hurting specific categories.

topicLedger.title: Query expansion remains negative
topicLedger.decision: Keep query expansion experimental and disabled as a default method until a same-data accepted shard win appears.
topicLedger.nextAction: Audit rewrite quality, fallback frequency, and category sensitivity before spending more full-shard cycles.

topicLedger.title: Wiki title and subtopic amplification are wired but unproven
topicLedger.evidence: q075-q078 retrieval slice completed; winner bm25-lite; promote=false; bm25-lite=0.1575; full-hybrid-rerank=0.1575; wiki-title-amplified-hybrid=0.1575; wiki-subtopic-amplified-hybrid=0.1575; wiki-summary-session-hybrid=0.1575.
topicLedger.decision: Do not promote title or subtopic boost until it wins accepted answer-quality shards, not just fixture or retrieval-proxy checks.
topicLedger.nextAction: Keep wiki title/subtopic/session arms benchmark-gated; use the bounded-pool q075 slice as runtime evidence, not promotion evidence.

topicLedger.title: Cloud provider arms are hybrid challengers, not pure vector replacements
topicLedger.evidence: q075-q078 provider retrieval slice completed; winner bm25-lite; promote=false; cloud-gemini2-embed-rerank-proxy=0.1575; cloud-nvidia-nv-embed-v1-mistral-rerank=0.1575.
topicLedger.decision: Keep Gemini/NVIDIA/Voyage/local provider arms behind the BM25-plus-hybrid candidate pool and require same-data answer-quality wins before promotion.
topicLedger.nextAction: Run provider challengers one provider at a time on larger or accepted answer-quality slices; keep Voyage rate-limit evidence separate from quality evidence.

topicLedger.title: Hosted Supermemory comparison is separate from local-full methodology
topicLedger.evidence: hosted canary quality 0; RecallWeave canary quality 0.1212; query count 8.
topicLedger.decision: Do not compare local-full partial shards to Supermemory reported SOTA or free-tier canaries as if they are the same benchmark.
topicLedger.nextAction: Use hosted Supermemory only in explicit hosted-baseline runs; keep it disabled for method refinement shards.

storagePolicy.rule: Use public wiki pages for method recall and private local indexes for raw evidence review.

nextActions: Use the completed local-full lane to guide method refinement while keeping full SOTA and production claims blocked.
Run a local-wiki shard plan before promoting title or subtopic amplification beyond fixture status.
Keep raw LongMemEval material outside repo-facing wiki artifacts; index it only in local private storage.
